criteria.evidence: Web interface is clean but requires understanding of audio-to-audio workflow. Learning curve moderate.
criteria.rationale: Interface is functional but not intuitive for non-technical users.

criteria.evidence: 12-16 seconds for 30s output. Very fast generation times.
criteria.rationale: Fastest system tested. Near real-time performance.

criteria.evidence: Excellent audio quality for bass/sustained tones. Clean output with minimal artifacts.
criteria.rationale: Best audio quality for compatible content types.

criteria.evidence: Excellent for rhythmic content (funk bassline). Poor for complex melodic lines (jazz).
criteria.rationale: Highly content-dependent. Works well within specialization.

criteria.evidence: Temperature, model selection, duration controls are effective. Input length discovery was key.
criteria.rationale: Good parameter control once workflow is understood.

criteria.evidence: Single instrument generation is native to audio-to-audio approach. No separation needed.
Seamless integration, 5 minutes to integrate, fully integrated result.
Fast iteration, good for bass/rhythmic ideation. Limited for melodic exploration.
criteria.rationale: Excellent workflow for specific use cases.

synthesis.top_strengths: Exceptional audio quality, fastest generation speed, seamless DAW integration, excellent for bass/rhythmic content
synthesis.top_weaknesses: Content-type limitations (poor for complex melodies), moderate learning curve, requires understanding of optimal input formats
synthesis.standout_feature: Short loop input discovery - system works better with 4-bar loops than full examples
synthesis.best_suited_for: Bass generation, rhythmic elements, single instrument audio-to-audio transformation
synthesis.not_recommended_for: Complex melodic lines, fast articulated instruments (brass, woodwinds), multi-instrument generation
synthesis.ideal_user_profile: Producers familiar with audio processing who need high-quality bass/rhythmic elements
